note: Irregularities found by this session. None is fixed in place; each has an owner.

items.title: Scheduled refresh failing at the commit step
items.detail: Recent scheduled `official data refresh` runs failed. Run 43864808752 (about 2 h before this audit, 19 s) failed at the step 'Commit refreshed captures and rebuilt outputs', read from the GitHub API. Run 43815576157 (about 8 h, 18 s) also failed; its failing step was not read. The run log could not be fetched with the tools in this session, so the cause is not established. The run before them, 43776978055, succeeded.
items.owner: refresh-job owner; PR #102 (arena/07f22dad-nba3) touches the same area

items.title: ATL @ MIL game book contradicts itself on Milwaukee Q3
items.detail: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-16 (arena/4054e125-nba3): the third read landed - the official game-page LINESCORES gives MIL Q3=27 (sums to the printed FINAL 106) and the AP recap on the same page (87-80 after three) corroborates 27; the feed settles with the LINESCORES quarters and the game-book conflict flagged (app/flagged.html 1116-F-01). Original finding: The period table prints 37 for Milwaukee in Q3; the summary line prints 27. Only 27 reproduces the printed FINAL of 106. The final is confirmed by the schedule, the summary line and the sum of the Bucks' player points in the same book. The Q3 split is therefore unresolved and must not be settled as a quarter-level result until a third read settles it.
items.owner: results-feed owner; a third official read of the game page LINESCORE

items.title: Five 11/15 finals are unsettled on main; PR #98 settles four
items.detail: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-16 (arena/4054e125-nba3): all nine 2026-11-15 finals are settled on the main feed (23 rows, quarters captured, settlement stamps visible) and the sealed ledger carries 9 settlement entries (43 total, chain intact); PR #98 was taken over and closed. Original finding: All nine 2026-11-15 games are Final on the official schedule. Main's result feed has no 11/15 rows and the ledger has zero settlements. Open PR #98 (arena/c94a5531-nba3) settles IND@PHI, LAL@PHX, CHA@LAC and SAS@UTA; its values match this audit's independent reads exactly. DAL@BOS, NYK@TOR, HOU@WAS, ATL@MIL and OKC@SAC are settled nowhere. The two published 11/15 moneyline picks (PHI, HOU) would both settle as wins.
items.owner: PR #98 owner (c94a5531) or the next refresh

items.title: Published window starts on a day already played
items.detail: The published window is 2026-11-15 → 2026-11-18 (snapshot manifest and landing page). Today is 2026-11-16 UTC and all nine 11/15 games are Final. The window should roll to 11/16 → 11/19.

items.title: Injuries banner is a day behind and prints two retrieval stamps
items.detail: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-16 (arena/4054e125-nba3): the injuries banner now shows the newest archived report (revision 2026-11-16 01:15 PM ET) with its retrieval stamp and a consecutive-report diff in section 1d. Original finding: The banner shows revision 2026-11-15 06:15 AM ET. The official index lists 39 reports for 2026-11-16, the newest at 9:30 AM ET. An earlier read of the same index in this session recorded 27 reports to 9:15 AM; the page as fetched for this audit lists 39, so the index changed during the session or the earlier count was wrong (recorded, not resolved). The banner prints retrieval 2026-11-15T11:40Z in one place and 11:33Z in another.

items.title: Arena coordinates are sourced from Wikipedia, not an official source
items.detail: data/app/arena_coordinates.json states its source as Wikipedia article coordinates and says the NBA does not publish coordinates. The brief requires official sources. Two arenas have no coordinates and are blank. Every travel distance inherits this gap.

items.title: Standings are not captured by the scheduled job
items.detail: scripts/refresh_official.py fetches the injury index, schedule and results pages, game books and the three team-stat pages. It has no standings URL (zero matches for 'standings'). The brief requires standings.

items.title: No closing line or odds feed; market-anchored prior cannot be built
items.detail: pipeline/v2/strategies.py states there is no closing line in the repository and no licensed odds feed. The NBA terms restrict gambling use of NBA statistics (flagged on the site as NF-12).
items.owner: owner decision on a licensed feed; counsel

items.title: Top-8 minute shares measured from a single day
items.detail: scripts/minutes_model.py prefers top-8 shares measured from the 2026-11-14 game books (five games) and falls back to a season snapshot where a team is missing. The measured shares rest on one slate.

items.title: Per-player logs cover one day, not every injury-report player
items.detail: data/app/player_game_logs.json has 173 rows, all from 2026-11-14 (five games, ten teams). The coverage note says players on teams that did not play that day are absent, which is 20 of 30 teams. Props and rho cannot be measured for those teams from this capture.

items.title: Possession × PPP totals model does not beat the baseline
items.detail: pipeline/v2/build.py flags FV2-08: the total RMSE does not beat the naive baseline of about 18.0. The model is published as a negative result.

items.title: Not every injury PDF is stored
items.detail: The official index lists 39 reports for 11/16 alone. The repository stores a selection of 11/13–11/15 reports. The brief requires every PDF stored with its timestamp.

items.title: Two results feeds and two ledgers exist
items.detail: data/live/results/ and data/app/results_feed.json are separate feeds; ledger/ and data/app/ledger/ are separate chains. Two sources of truth invite disagreement.

items.title: Two pre-registration sets exist
items.detail: prereg/ holds three strategy files and data/app/prereg/ holds fifteen. The binding set is not named.

items.title: Five open PRs touch shared outputs
items.detail: Open PRs #94, #95, #96, #98 and #102 change shared files (data/app, app/, pages.yml, COORDINATION.md). Merging them in any order risks conflicts.

items.title: Landing page leads with counts, not the disagreement headline
items.detail: The landing page opens with the origination sentence and tile counts. The ledger headline is the disagreement, but the page does not show it first (see R13).

items.title: Two ledger trees with different schemas; the second cannot be hash-verified
items.detail: ledger/ledger.jsonl (11 PUBLISH entries) verifies: every prev_hash, entry_hash and pick_sha256 recomputes. data/app/ledger/ledger.jsonl (34 lines, body/entry_hash schema) keeps an unbroken prev_hash link on every line, but its entry_hash does not recompute from its body under four canonical forms tried in this audit, so the hash recipe is undocumented. The 0022600238-side-proj entry (line 3) is PUBLISHED_PRE_TIP and is not a linkage break. The 'CHAIN BROKEN' note on PR #102 was not reproduced as a linkage break; its verifier is not in the repo. Do not settle from tree B until its recipe is documented and it is re-verified.
